Dave Matthews Band
November 5, 2022
Moda Center - Portland, OR

*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Mixing: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 6 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: GA Floor, House Left Rear Rail, Aligned w/ House Right Stack, Approx. 45' from Stage, Mics PAS @ 15'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.69 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > WAV (32 Bit Float @ 48) > Audacity 3.2.1 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

12. Rapunzel
13. Lying in the Hands of God³

15. Lover Lay Down

17. #41
18. You & Me⁵
19. Dancing Nancies >
20. Ants Marching⁶
21. Encore Break
22. Don't Drink the Water⁷

Set Time: [02:34:04.947]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals

Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals

Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ with prelude
² Also Sprach Zarathustra and Heartbreaker interpolations
³ American Baby Intro and Bourbons & Lacs interpolations
⁴ Led Zeppelin cover
⁵ with Hope for Tomorrow prelude
⁶ with Carter solo intro and Shake Your Body (Down to the Ground) interpolation
⁷ with prelude with Forty Six & 2 and Schism interpolations, Tim delay outro

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.
